audit_items.proof_trace: When endSlot < minStartSlot (L198-200), validateDataColumnsByRange returns (nil, nil), causing the handler to return nil at L74 without sending responseCodeResourceUnavailable. This silently accepts out-of-range requests instead of rejecting them with error code 0x03 as required by the P2P spec.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker sends DataColumnSidecarsByRangeRequest with startSlot far in the past (before minStartSlot). The node silently closes the stream with success instead of responding with ResourceUnavailable error code, violating the P2P protocol specification and potentially causing peer discovery/sync issues.
